action: An engineer reads a Terraform plan and decides whether the replacement is acceptable.
A model explains the required_providers block and returns a draft. It cannot read or edit the repository.
An agent reads approved repository files and proposes a repair plan. It cannot edit files or run commands.
An agent edits one allowed Terraform file, runs fmt and validate, returns the diff and evidence, and stops before apply.
After a human approves an exact saved plan, a delivery identity applies that plan once and records the result.
A scheduled agent uses read-only tools to compare desired and current state and writes a drift report.
An agent decides that an unused bucket is wasteful and deletes it without a task contract or approval.
An inspection task asks for administrator credentials, unrestricted network access, and permission to edit any repository file.
